messages:
sarah: Heads up — Acme Marketplace requested our SOC2 report, a 3rd-party pen test window, and answers to their security questionnaire. They also want an artifacts bundle (logs, configs) uploaded to their S3. Who can own scope + upload plan?

mike: I can own pen test scope. Need to confirm whether they accept a redacted bundle or want raw logs. Also need to pick vendor window. :thinking:

anna: I can coordinate uploads and presigned links. We should avoid putting raw logs in a public presign. Use their secure S3 with cross-account role or our presign bucket with short TTL.

josh: Legal: we'll need a DPA + an evidence transfer attestation. Also check their questionnaire for any data residency clauses. If logs contain customer PII we must redact or provide pseudonymized extracts.

sarah: Good call. For timeline, they want artifacts in 2 weeks. Pen test window ideally next week. Can we compress artifact production? We need an artifact manifest and owner map.

mike: Proposed pen scope: external / marketplace endpoints + auth flows + integrations with SI partners. Exclude internal admin consoles. I'll draft `pen_scope.md` and share.

anna: For artifact tech plan:
- produce zipped bundle named `acme_listing_<date>_redacted.zip`
- include `manifest.csv` with checksums
- PGP-sign the manifest
- upload to `s3://marketplace-evidence/acme/<listing>/` with 24h presign links
- set TTL for owners to download within 72h

sarah: Love that. Anna, can you make a template for manifest and TTL policy? We'll need to communicate to Acme which files are redacted.

anna: Yep. I'll post the template to the partner drive and link here.

deploy-bot: New upload bucket created: `s3://marketplace-evidence-acme-2026` (owner: partner-ops)

mike: Pen test vendor: can we use RapidSignal? They already did our infra last year but not marketplace surface. If not, I'll ask CrowdPLA.

josh: Make sure contract covers non-disclosure for the vendor. Also, confirm whether the vendor requires IP access or a test account. If test accounts are needed, security to issue scoped creds.

sarah: Action items:
- mike: pen scope + vendor ask (due EOD)
- anna: manifest + upload policy + presign TTL (48h?) (due tomorrow)
- josh: DPA check + vendor NDA template (due tomorrow)
- me: coordinate with Acme on required artifacts & confirm whether they accept redacted logs (due EOD)

mike: 48h TTL ok. Also recommend storing artifacts encrypted at rest (SSE-KMS) and adding an access log for downloads.

anna: Noted. I'll enable SSE-KMS and add CloudTrail log export to the artifact folder.

sarah: Thanks. I'll ping acme@acmelistings.com after lunch with the proposed schedule.

mike: Quick question — does marketplace require pen testing of our SI partners' connectors too? That would expand scope a lot.

sarah: Acme asked for SI integration evidence. Let's ask them if they need full pen of 3rd-party connectors or just attestations + vendor reports.

anna: If they accept vendor attestations, ask for SOC or pen certs from the SI partners. Otherwise we'll need to coordinate separate windows.

josh: Also check whether they need signatures on attestation forms. We should prepare a template.

sarah: OK wrapping up here. I'll post an updated checklist later. Thanks everyone :pray:
